senses.gloss:
√bhur 'quiver'
present: [6.] bhurántu bhuránta bhurámāṇa 
secondary: intensive: járbhurīti járbhurat járbhurāṇa bhuraṇa bhurváṇi RV. bhū́rṇi V. bhuríj? V.+ 
Doubtless a specialized root-form from √bhṛ; all the forms and derivatives such as might come from √bhṛ: cf. √tṛ.
√bhuraj\nThe single form bhurajanta RV1. is regarded as coming from √bhṛjj 'roast'.
